description: Extract values from an array of objects by property path, optionally re-wrapping them under a new key.
label: Array Map

options.name: array
options.label: Array
options.info: The array of objects to map over.

options.name: path
options.label: Path
options.info: Dot-separated path to the property to extract from each item. For example, 'user.name'

options.name: targetPath
options.label: Target Path
options.info: Optional. Dot-separated key to wrap the extracted value in. For example, 'label' returns [{ label: value }], 'user.name' returns [{ user: { name: value } }]

options.name: resultModel
options.label: Result
options.info: The mapped array, typed to the source array's model.

options.name: resultSchema
options.label: Result
options.info: The mapped array as a schema-typed array.
